method: One joint at a time, operator-described physical movements with read-only encoder observations

front_left_hip_roll.physical_cue: outward, away from the body centerline
front_left_hip_roll.operator_observation: outward makes ticks decrease; inward makes ticks increase
front_left_hip_roll.reverse_check: operator reported inverse movement changes ticks in the opposite direction

front_left_hip_pitch.operator_observation: forward makes ticks decrease; backward makes ticks increase
front_left_hip_pitch.reverse_check: operator reported inverse movement changes ticks in the opposite direction

front_left_knee_pitch.physical_cue: bend/flex the knee so the foot moves closer to the hip
front_left_knee_pitch.operator_observation: lower leg backward makes ticks decrease; forward makes ticks increase
front_left_knee_pitch.reverse_check: operator reported inverse movement changes ticks in the opposite direction
